reviews.comment: Three tests graded on a curve. 6 homework's graded generously. Offers bonus towards the end if you show up. She knows so much about the topic and was funny, but would spend too much time on explaining how to do the math. Her tests were hard, but the material is hard. I think she did a really good job with the required material.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class is hard, but her curves on exams are amazing. She is a boring lecturer, but is so knowledgeable that it makes you interested. I had to teach a lot of it to myself to get the grade I got, but a lot of it came from reading the textbook. Only thing that sucks is that the class is extremely test heavy so you have to do good on those.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment:
Pros: Great professor, curves all tests, hw grading is very generous, she gives good practice for the exams, and overall you can tell she cares about her students.

Cons: The only cons I have are just the class being hard. There are only 3 tests and 6 homeworks due.  I don't blame her for teaching a difficult class.

She has good lectures and covers everything you need to know for the exams. But I learned everything myself and got the grade I wanted.  3 Exams are 90%  of your grade but lots of courses are like that. She gives curves on exams and maybe a free answer or two   Homework is graded lightly
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She's very nice but doesn't really give good practice problems and her English ability is good but not great as she mumbles a lot she's not necessarily an awful teacher she's just a researcher being made to teach.

Please take her if you can. I took this class at the same time my roommate did with another prof and it was night and day. She does so much to help you learn and a lot of what you learn is actually applicable to the real world. 10/10 professor and 10/10 class, not hard to study for at all.

3 exams, 6 HWs—fairly easy. Prof is nice but reads from slides and moves slowly, so lectures get boring fast. I stopped paying attention and learned most of it on my own from the slides. Exams include current economic stats. Focus on concepts over math but make sure you know how to use the equations.

From lectures, you can tell Professor Jo is incredibly smart. She does a thorough job at teaching concepts and provides practice for exams. My only struggle is she sometimes got so caught up in the small details/math that you lost sight of the overall concept. Grades were exams and homework. Homework was good prep for the exams.

Class graded mostly by 3 tests, which are curved very well. Lectures are hard to follow sometimes, she tends to move quickly and use alot of math. She provides ample study materials to ensure you know whats on the test.

I did well in the class, but I learned pretty much everything by myself.  She teaches the information in class, but I don't think she moves at a great pace so I get super bored and have completely stopped paying attention by the end of each lecture. She's nice, but my learning happened through the optional textbook and the slides she posts.

This class is hard, but this professor does such a good job of explaining everything. She curves on the tests and will go over examples multiple times until you understand. She will also meet you outside of class to help. It is a hard class though, but it's not her fault.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: You can tell that she is really passionate about econ and knows a lot. I thought the material was really straightforward & she did a good job explaining it. Tests were decent, she curves a decent amount too. Homeworks and practice exams really helped to study.

If you have to take Econ 410 take Yoon; she definitely the best choice. It's a hard class and her lectures are confusing and don't help too much. Furthermore, her tests are incredibly difficult and the class is essentially weighted solely off three tests. However, she gives curves, is super nice, and gives practice exams that are incredibly helpful
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Jo was very nice. Was willing to meet outside of office hours on the weekend to help me get ready for a test. Was very lenient with grading exams. Read directly off of the PowerPoint. Frequently had to go to the textbook to understand what she was teaching. The exams are similar to the practice problems. Good professor but not a great class.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Had to take this class as an Econ Major and it has easily been one of the most confusing classes I have taken at A&M so far. Obviously this was not supposed to be an easy class, but the lectures did not make it much easier. The material is taught at an extremely fast pace, and is practically impossible to keep up with notes in class. Exams are hard
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class is very similar in format to other economics classes, with even some overlap in material. Professor Yoon is very caring and even takes the time to try and remember all of the students' names. As long as you try to understand the material and show up to class, this class isn't too bad. She also gives pretty big curves for her tests.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: 410 is never going to be a super easy class, but Yoon makes it okay. You will have to fully understand all her PowerPoints to do well on the tests, but there's not really any surprises. Tests were crazy hard (class average was something like a 27%), but she gave us an insane curve (added something like 60 points to every test), so don't freak out.
